commit 142f5e87283c48b1694b2c786bee09a563cfa50b
Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
AuthorDate: Tue May 19 15:32:45 2026 -0400
Commit:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
CommitDate: Tue May 19 15:32:45 2026 -0400

    Bug 2040560 - Update libotr toolchain build to use macOS SDK 26.5. r=darktrojan
    
    
    Port of https://hg.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/rev/b3b333e06a9d
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D301282

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml
index 7664c51c733..13d65f1bbaf 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/libotr.yml
@@ -45,7 +45,7 @@ macosx64-x64-libotr:
         symbol: TM(libotr)
     worker:
         env:
-            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX26.4.sdk"
+            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX26.5.sdk"
             MACOS_TARGET_SDK: "10.15"
     run:
         arguments: ['macosx64']
@@ -61,7 +61,7 @@ macosx64-aarch64-libotr:
         symbol: TMA64(libotr)
     worker:
         env:
-            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX26.4.sdk"
+            MACOS_SDK_DIR: "MacOSX26.5.sdk"
             MACOS_TARGET_SDK: "11.0"
     run:
         arguments: ['macosx64-aarch64']
diff --git a/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh b/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh
index 3954f984c4e..e4e237cd116 100755
--- a/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/scripts/build-libotr.sh
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@ GECKO_PATH=${GECKO_PATH:-"/builds/worker/workspace/build/src"}
 MOZ_FETCHES_DIR=${MOZ_FETCHES_DIR:-"/builds/worker/fetches"}
 UPLOAD_DIR=${UPLOAD_DIR:-"/builds/worker/artifacts"}
 WORKSPACE=${WORKSPACE:-"${HOME}/workspace"}
-MACOS_SDK_DIR=${MACOS_SDK_DIR:-"MacOSX26.4.sdk"}
+MACOS_SDK_DIR=${MACOS_SDK_DIR:-"MacOSX26.5.sdk"}
 MACOS_TARGET_SDK=${MACOS_TARGET_SDK:-"10.15"}
title: Bug 2040560 - Update libotr toolchain build to use macOS SDK 26.5. r=darktrojan
